versions.changelog:
**Initial release of ai-address-parser – Parse unstructured address text into structured fields using an LLM.**

- Converts messy pasted address text (from emails, maps, business cards) into structured address fields via an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint.
- Provides clear schema and prompt design guidelines to ensure accurate field extraction and safe handling of ambiguous input.
- Handles API responses defensively and enforces field length limits server-side.
- Merges parsed results into forms non-destructively—never overwrites fields the user has already filled.
- Includes instructions for testing various input scenarios and addresses bilingual field extraction requirements.
